verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core purpose is chatting with your own documents. First-party claims say every document becomes part of the agent's knowledge base and that RAG works out of the box, and a hands-on user ran it over a batch of regulatory PDFs and got largely correct answers. That user also found the citations window showed garbled content, which weakens source attribution for grounded answers. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of supported document/note formats and ingestion, reliable citation display.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them

citations.quote: Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
Chat with your docs, use AI Agents, hyper-configurable, multi-user, & no frustrating setup required.
RAG, agents, and work right out of the box
